mutations.name: a task carried by two coordinators is guessed onto the first
kills: coord.cards attribution leaves a PR unattributed when two coordinators' implementers carried its task

mutations.name: a failed title read drops every card
kills: coord.cards enrichment and failures keeps every card with task ids and no titles when the active-work read rejects

mutations.name: attribution only sees the day's own spawns
kills: coord.cards attribution attributes a PR merged today to the coordinator that spawned its agent yesterday, without counting that agent today

mutations.name: titles come from the whole task tree again
kills: coord.cards enrichment and failures titles are read for the cards' task ids only

mutations.name: the cards wait on the titles read however long it takes
kills: coord.cards enrichment and failures serves the cards without titles when the titles read is still running, so a busy active-work never holds coord.cards
